data.narrative:
DG Matrix is a Series A-stage climate and energy company founded by Haroon Inam and Subhashish Bhattacharya that has raised over $100M to date. The valuation exercise draws from a comp universe of 9 peers in the Climate & Energy sector, including 1 public comparable (LNZA) and 8 private companies such as Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

Stage-progression methodology applies here as the primary valuation method. Using the $100M total capital raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A progression, this method implies a valuation of $200M. A peer-median approach was not applicable given insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow Climate & Energy cohort to support a reliable median—while 8 sector peers exist, none met the filters for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar valuation tier required for statistical validity.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $170M to $230M, with a median point of $200M. This range reflects the stage-progression output with reasonable sensitivity bounds. Key uncertainties include the absence of near-identical stage and sector peers for cross-validation, the reliance on a single applicable method, and potential divergence between capital raised and fair value in an early-stage context. Further data on comparable Series A exits or revenue multiples in this subsector would materially strengthen conviction in the median estimate.
